description:
This posting is for a process engineer / expert in image processing and vision systems. Responsible for optimizing and troubleshooting automated image processing processes, focusing on quality control while reducing cycle times and improving manufacturing yields.
  Process owner and technical expert for existing image processing and vision systems (i.e. Cognex, Halcon, NeuroCheck, Keyence) within the plant and as a member of the Bosch Center of Competency and the International Production Network
 Specifying, validating, debugging and improving machine vision systems, sensors, cameras and lighting setups for automated assembly defect inspection
 Utilize data driven methods to resolve complex production issues, resolve bottlenecks, reduce false reject rates and maximize overall equipment effectiveness
 Lead development and implementation of new processes, new technologies, equipment upgrades and projects to reduce cycle time and improve manufacturing yields
 Define, document and manage critical process parameters and vision system programs
 Collaborate with internal and external partners (process development, quality, suppliers, production, logistics, quality) for process and equipment optimizations
 Communication and participation with lead plants and expert teams on latest technologies and process improvements
 Project management and ability to lead teams
 Mentor and train associates in all facets of vision system processes
 
 The qualified applicant must: 
 Have a Bachelor of Science Degree in Engineering (or similar field)
 Be a self-starter and innately curious, with the ability and willingness to dive into and lead development of technical processes
 Have minimum three years' experience in automated, industrial manufacturing
  Have experience with image processing, vision systems and creating vision system programs
 Be comfortable with cross functional activities and international teams
 Be structured and systematic in his / her / their work approach, willing to adapt to dynamic changes and multi-tasking
 Be willing and able to travel internationally
 Communicate effectively at all levels of the organization
 Strong augmentation of the candidate profile would include experience with: 
 Vision systems, lighting, cameras and sensors
 Equipment maintenance and management (PM, TPM)
 PLC programming, industrial control technologies
 Problem solving methodology and root cause analysis (8D, 5-Why, Shainin or Six Sigma)
 Quality management systems
 Strong documentation skills
 German or English language background
 Machine vision principles including optics, image acquisition, camera calibration, lighting techniques, OCR/OCV, pattern matching, and image processing algorithms
 Selecting and configuring industrial cameras, lenses, filters, lighting systems, and image acquisition hardware
 3D vision technologies, laser profiling, structured light systems, or robotic guidance applications is preferred
 Integrating vision systems with industrial robots for inspection, positioning, or guidance applications
 Industrial networks, sensors, I/O systems, and machine controls architecture
 SPC methodologies and interpreting Cp/Cpk studies to establish and maintain process capability
 Conducting Measurement Systems Analysis (MSA), Gauge R&R studies and process validation activities
 Experience utilizing data analysis tools such as Python, SQL Minitab, JMP, Power BI or equivalent to identify process trends and optimize vision system performance
 Software development or scripting languages (Python, C#, C++, VB.NET) is desirable
 
 Benefits 
 Competitive Salary
 Competitive Time Away from Work Policy
 Paid Time Off (PTO): 16 days (Up to 30 days based on seniority)
 Personal Days (PAA): 5 days

 401k - 75% match up to the first 9% contribution
 Unique Bosch Defined Contribution (BDC) plan provides 100% company-funded 401(k) contributions , ranging from 2.5% to 6.5% of your pay, helping you secure your financial future
 Student Debt Retirement Savings Match
 Profit Sharing Bonus (CPrP) up to 10%
 Medical, dental, and vision coverage
 Onsite Cafeteria with multiple menu options
 Onsite Starbucks Cafe
